ordinary_counterexample_argument.text:
Ordinary source-specific counterexample argument for T>=4,beta>0
================================================================

Evidence role: ORDINARY_PROOF_CANDIDATE, NOT A LEAN DECLARATION OR ACCEPTANCE
RECEIPT. The coordinate marginal, auxiliary integral operator, infinite-rank
argument and observable sequence below have not been formalized in the Lean
closure. All compilation, fresh replay and transitive axiom facets remain
NOT_RUN. The three uploaded Lean files still prove only the mixed estimate
and the beta=0/T=3 special cases. This argument assumes no physical transfer
operator, no source spectral decomposition and no unproved kernel lower bound.

1. Exact source coordinates.

Fix T>=4, beta>0 and L=2*T>=8. Write a vertex as (r,s), r in Z/LZ and
s in (Z/LZ)^3, identifying spatial direction i in Fin3 with i+1 in Fin4.
Set a_r(s,i)=U((r,s),i+1) and g_r(s)=U((r,s),0). This is a literal
bijection of the existing positive links with all spatial-slice links and
all temporal links, so reference Haar is the product of their actual
normalized Haar marginals. Nothing is gauge fixed or deleted.

Let X=SU2^{((Z/LZ)^3 x Fin3)}, nu its product Haar, and let H=SU2^{(Z/LZ)^3}
with its product Haar dg. Put E_s=P_s=3*L^3 for the spatial link/plaquette
cardinalities. Let V(a) be the sum of the actual spatial plaquette penalties
on a slice. Then 0<=V<=2*P_s by the maintained penalty bound.

For a,b in X define
  M(a)=exp(-beta*V(a)/2),
  W(a,b)=product_e exp(-beta*penalty(a_e*b_e^{-1})),
  (g.b)_(s,i)=g_s*b_(s,i)*g_(s+e_i)^{-1},
  K(a,b)=M(a)*M(b)*integral_H W(a,g.b) dg.

The temporal plaquette at (r,s), directions 0,i+1, is literally
  g_r(s)*a_(r+1)(s,i)*g_r(s+e_i)^{-1}*a_r(s,i)^{-1}.
Its penalty equals that of a_r(s,i)*(g_r.a_(r+1))_(s,i)^{-1},
using the existing penalty_inv theorem. Thus integrating each actual
temporal layer gives the displayed gauge average W. The two half spatial
weights in each adjacent K multiply to exp(-beta*V(a_r)) around the circle.
Fubini therefore gives the exact cyclic spatial marginal
  Z = integral_(X^L) product_(r in Z/LZ) K(a_r,a_(r+1)) dnu^L,
and the same identity with any continuous spatial-slice observable inserted.
Here Z is the existing wilsonPartition(L,beta), not a replacement normalizer.
All factors are continuous on compact finite products, hence integrable.
Every temporal Haar integration and every spatial/time plaquette is retained.

2. Properties derived for this actual K.

Continuity follows from continuity of all matrix/group factors and integration
over compact probability H. The maintained 0<=penalty<=2 gives, rather than
assumes, the pointwise bounds
  exp(-2*beta*(P_s+E_s)) <= K(a,b) <= 1.
The lower constant is used only to make 1/K continuous and bounded on X^2.
It is not an operator or quadratic-form lower bound.

Actual two-sided Haar change of variables and simultaneous gauge invariance of
W show K(h.a,k.b)=K(a,b) for independent slice gauges h,k. The same changes,
penalty_inv and interchange of a,b prove K(a,b)=K(b,a). Thus K is a real
symmetric, separately gauge-invariant continuous kernel.

3. Construct the auxiliary integral operator and prove its properties.

On the real Hilbert space H_inv of gauge-invariant L2(X,nu) classes define
  (A f)(a)=integral_X K(a,b)*f(b) dnu(b).
This is a definition from the actual marginal, not an assumed transfer
operator. H_inv is closed since every actual gauge map is measure preserving.
K bounded and nu probability give a bounded L2 map. Symmetry gives
self-adjointness, and separate gauge invariance puts its image in H_inv.
Every nonzero-eigenvalue eigenfunction has an actual continuous,
pointwise gauge-invariant representative lambda^{-1} A f: uniform continuity
of K on compact X^2 and f in L1 prove continuity of this integral.

To pay positivity, concatenate the eight actual real matrix-entry coordinates
over every spatial link. The maintained SU2 trace/Gram identity gives
  W(a,b)=exp(-beta*E_s)*exp((beta/2)*Gram(Phi(a),Phi(b))).
The scalar exponential series, finite tensor-word expansion, Fubini and
dominated convergence give a nonnegative weighted sum of squared moments.
For L2 functions the domination is a finite constant times |f(a)*f(b)|,
integrable since the measure is a probability and L2 is contained in L1.
Thus W has a nonnegative quadratic form. For nonzero continuous real f
the form is strictly positive: if it vanished, beta/2>0 makes every
coordinate-monomial moment zero; coordinate polynomials contain constants
and separate points of the actual compact matrix configuration X.
Stone-Weierstrass approximates f uniformly by those polynomials, forcing
integral f^2=0. Full support of Haar then forces f=0, a contradiction.
Full support follows directly from normalized compact Haar: finitely many
left translates of a nonempty open set cover the group; a measure-zero
such set would contradict total mass1. Finite product Haar has the same
property.

Gauge averaging does not weaken that conclusion on the invariant space:
for gauge-invariant f, M*f is invariant, and actual Haar changes give
  <f,A f> = <M*f, W(M*f)>.
Consequently A is positive, and its form is strictly positive on every
nonzero continuous gauge-invariant f.

A is compact: by Stone-Weierstrass on X^2, approximate K uniformly by finite
sums p_j(a)*q_j(b). Their integral operators have finite rank, and the
L2 operator-norm error is at most the uniform kernel error (nu is a
probability). Hence A is a norm limit of finite-rank operators.

A has infinite rank on H_inv. Fix one actual spatial plaquette. Its real
trace takes every value in [-2,2]: put diag(exp(i theta),exp(-i theta)) on
one of its four distinct links and identity on every other link. Its
powers are continuous gauge-invariant functions, linearly independent
pointwise and in L2 by full support. If A had finite rank, a nonzero
finite linear combination of sufficiently many of these functions would
lie in ker(A), contradicting strict positivity on continuous invariant
functions. No finite-dimensionality of continuous observables is assumed.

4. Obtain actual continuous eigenfunctions, rather than postulate a source
spectral decomposition.

Apply the compact self-adjoint spectral theorem to the operator just
constructed on H_inv. Positivity and infinite rank give a unit real
continuous gauge-invariant eigenfunction u_* with lambda_*>0, and a sequence
of unit real continuous gauge-invariant eigenfunctions u_n with
lambda_n>0 and lambda_n->0. Nonzero eigenspaces have finite multiplicity;
infinitely many eigenvalues bounded away from zero would contradict
compactness on their orthonormal eigenvectors. Continuity and pointwise
gauge invariance were supplied in step3. The generic compact spectral and
Stone-Weierstrass results are standard upstream mathematics; their use here
still needs actual Lean instantiation. No vacuum or physical Hamiltonian is
identified with these objects.

5. Actual allowed observables.

For every n define on the original full configuration
  F_n(U)=u_*(a_1(U))*u_n(a_2(U))/K(a_1(U),a_2(U)),
viewed as a complex observable by the real embedding.
The proved pointwise positivity of this actual K makes F_n continuous.
Independent slice-gauge invariance of u_*,u_n,K proves invariance under
every original four-dimensional vertex gauge. It depends only on spatial
links at times1,2, whose two endpoints lie in1,...,T-2 because T>=4.
Therefore F_n belongs to the precise actual twoStepDomain. No foreign
observable algebra, grid or support domain is substituted.

The actual translation gives tau F_n from slices2,3. The actual bond
reflection sends spatial slice r to 1-r, so F_n(Theta U) uses ordered
slices (0,L-1); (tau F_n)(Theta U) uses (L-1,L-2). Spatial links are not
inverted under this reflection.

6. Compute both exact quadratic values.

Write K^[r](a,b) for the r-fold integral convolution, retaining all r-1
intermediate slice integrations, not an entrywise power.
The source cyclic marginal and the two reflection incidences above give,
after the two internal K factors cancel their two positive denominators,
  Z*q(F_n)
    = integral_(a,b,c,d)
        u_*(d)*u_n(c)*u_*(a)*u_n(b)
        *K(d,a)*K^[L-3](b,c) dnu^4
    = lambda_* * lambda_n^(L-3),
and
  Z*q(tau F_n)
    = integral_(a,b,c,d)
        u_*(d)*u_n(c)*u_*(a)*u_n(b)
        *K^[3](d,a)*K^[L-5](b,c) dnu^4
    = lambda_*^3 * lambda_n^(L-5).
For the first expression the two retained gaps have lengths1 and L-3;
for the shifted expression they have lengths3 and L-5. In both cases
the two internal observed-slice edges account for the remaining2 edges
of the length-L circle. K symmetry accounts for the reversed internal
edge of the reflected observable. Every long gap is integrated by its
convolution kernel. The equalities to eigenvalues follow by the defining
integral eigenfunction equations and unit L2 normalization, iterated only
as raw kernel integrations. All such integrals have continuous bounded
factors on compact finite products. Both exponents are positive for L>=8.

Z>0, lambda_*>0 and lambda_n>0 give q(F_n)>0 and
  q(tau F_n)/q(F_n) = (lambda_*/lambda_n)^2 -> infinity.
These are actual continuous gauge-invariant observables of the original
two-step domain. Thus this ordinary argument, if accepted in its stated
source bridges, refutes every finite C_(T,beta) at each fixed T>=4,beta>0.
It does not merely exhibit an abstract thermal-circle model.

7. Reconstruction meaning and formal boundary.

After an actual quotient norm with norm([F])^2=q(F) is constructed, the
normalized actual classes [F_n]/sqrt(q(F_n)) have norm1 and translated
norms lambda_*/lambda_n -> infinity. A bounded extension on the closure
of the actual image domain would contradict these values. No full-space
density assumption is used.

The beta=0 case is different: K=1 is rank one, so step4 does not produce
this sequence; the actual Lean candidate proves q(tau F)=q(F).
At T=3 the two-slice observables are outside the original one-slice support
domain; the actual Lean candidate instead proves contraction with C=1.

Formal completion of this counterexample still requires constructing the
spatial/temporal coordinate bijection and exact marginal, the actual K and
gauge changes, its compact positive infinite-rank integral operator, the
continuous eigenfunction sequence and the two source quadratic evaluations.
None is supplied as an axiom, certificate field or conditional Lean wrapper.
No such Lean closure or accepted general refutation is claimed.
The next concrete formal task is the coordinate bijection and actual
cyclic Haar marginal in step1. No manuscript, physical time evolution,
vacuum/whole ground sector, continuum limit or mass gap is constructed.
